title: How I can be so attracted to someone after I've dreamt about them, when I never cared for them before in real life?
content: So, when I dream about someone, I end up feeling a whole new vibe when I see them in real life. It's like I'm drawn to them or feel a special connection out of the blue. It's so intriguing, right? I can't help but wonder why that happens. Whenever I dream about them, I get this sudden curiosity and attraction towards them. I just feel this urge to dig deeper and learn more about them.
